en.title: Shotsy Alternative for GLP-1 Users: An Honest 2026 Comparison — HAVIT vs Shotsy
en.meta_description: Looking for a Shotsy alternative on Ozempic or Zepbound? What Shotsy's shot tracker does well, where it stops, and how an all-in-one GLP-1 app compares.
en.tldr: Looking for a Shotsy alternative on Ozempic or Zepbound? What Shotsy's shot tracker does well, where it stops, and how an all-in-one GLP-1 app compares.
en.body_md:
*Medical disclaimer: This article is for general education only and is not medical advice, diagnosis, or dosing guidance. GLP-1 medications are prescription drugs with serious potential risks. Always follow your prescriber's instructions and the FDA-approved label, and never change your dose based on an app.*

If you searched for a "Shotsy alternative," you probably already like the idea of a dedicated GLP-1 tracker — you just want to know whether something fits your journey better. Maybe you want more than a shot log: body composition, habit-building, and coaching that keeps you consistent past week one. This is an honest, vendor-neutral comparison. Shotsy is a genuinely good app; we'll be clear about what it does well and where an all-in-one wellness app pulls ahead.

## What Shotsy Does Well

Shotsy is built around the weekly (or daily) GLP-1 dose, and it does that job cleanly.

### One-tap dose logging and a real injection-site map

Log a shot or a pill in a single tap and keep a full medication history. Shotsy gives you a **visual body map to rotate injection sites** — the feature that separates a purpose-built tracker from a repurposed calorie app, because repeatedly injecting the same spot can cause lumps or irritation ([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### Smart reminders and next-dose countdowns

Set precise schedules for weekly injections or daily oral doses, with countdowns and next-dose notifications so a once-weekly shot doesn't slip past you.

### Side-effect logging tied to your dose

Customizable side-effect logs let you record nausea, headaches, or fatigue and associate them with a specific dose, site, or meal — useful because 40–70% of GLP-1 users experience GI side effects ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### Broad medication support and 2026 updates

Shotsy covers Ozempic, Wegovy (shot and pill), Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda, and more. Version 3.0 (March 2026) added **oral GLP-1 pill tracking** and a **Maintenance Mode** for users at goal weight, plus nutrition, protein, and water logging and Apple Health sync ([Shotsy on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## Where Shotsy Falls Short for All-in-One Users

None of this is a knock on Shotsy — it's a focused tool that does its core job well. But "great shot tracker" and "manages your whole GLP-1 journey" are different jobs. Here's the gap.

### 1. No body-composition view

GLP-1 weight loss isn't only fat. **The lean-mass share of weight lost on GLP-1 therapy has ranged from 40–60% in some trials to 15% or less in others** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy tracks weight, but it doesn't help you see muscle vs. fat — the number that tells you whether you're losing the *right* weight.

### 2. Logging, not behavior change

Shotsy records what happened. The harder problem — staying consistent through side-effect weeks and building habits that outlast the medication — is what leading guidance actually calls for: the USPSTF recommends intensive, multicomponent **behavioral** interventions for adults with obesity ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). A tracker logs; it doesn't coach.

### 3. No adaptive AI coach

Shotsy's reminders are scheduled, not conversational. If you want an assistant that reacts to your protein, your side effects, and your patterns — and nudges the next small step — that's a different product.

### 4. It's a single-purpose tool

If you also track food, protein, body composition, steps, and habits, you'll likely stitch Shotsy together with two or three other apps. An all-in-one keeps it in one place.

## Who Should Stay on Shotsy — and Who Should Switch

**Stay on Shotsy if:** you want a clean, focused shot tracker; the injection-site map and dose reminders are your top priority; and you already track food elsewhere or don't need to.

**Consider an alternative if:** you want body composition (muscle vs fat), habit-building and coaching around the shot, an AI assistant, or one app instead of three — or you'd prefer the experience in Korean, Japanese, or Traditional Chinese.

## What to Look For in a Shotsy Alternative

1. **Dose + guided injection-site rotation** — the non-negotiable core Shotsy already nails.
2. **Body composition** — muscle vs fat, not just scale weight, so you protect lean mass.
3. **Protein-first food logging** — appetite drops on a GLP-1; under-eating protein risks muscle loss.
4. **Habit & behavior-change support** — the part that keeps you consistent for months.
5. **An adaptive coach** — guidance that responds to your data, not just a scheduled ping.
6. **Privacy** — most U.S. wellness apps aren't HIPAA-covered; prefer clear export/delete controls.

## The Bottom Line

Shotsy is a strong, honest recommendation for anyone who wants a dedicated GLP-1 shot tracker — the injection-site map and reminders are genuinely good. The gap is everything *around* the shot: body composition, habits, and coaching. If you want the medication log **and** the muscle, the habits, and an AI coach in one place, an all-in-one is the better Shotsy alternative.

If that's you, **[try the HAVIT app](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — dose logging, protein-first food tracking, body composition, habit-building, and an AI coach, built to keep you consistent one week at a time.

## HAVIT: One App for Your Whole Healthy Lifestyle, Not Just Meals, Nutrition, and Calories

GLP-1 medications can meaningfully reduce weight — but the scale is only part of the story. The lean-mass share of the weight lost on GLP-1 therapy has ranged from 40–60% in some trials to 15% or less in others — and lean mass counts organs, bone and fluid, not only muscle ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), and results tend to fade once the medication stops unless new habits take their place — which is why the USPSTF recommends intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT is an AI diet coach app built by experts from Juvis Diet, one of Korea's leading diet clinics.** It goes beyond tracking meals, nutrition, and calories. Body composition, sleep, exercise, and mental well-being all live in the same app. At the clinic, staff guided members through three steps: analyze the body, set number-based goals, and coach every day. HAVIT brings that same flow to your phone.

**Here's what a clinical study found.** In a 12-week clinical study with Eulji University, **31.7%** of the HAVIT group lost 5% or more of their body weight, compared with 8.1% of the control group (about **3.9x**). **83%** of the HAVIT group lowered their body fat percentage, compared with 49% of the control group. The study ran June–August 2026 and analyzed 78 people (HAVIT 41, control 37) who had InBody results from both weeks 1 and 12. It was a non-blinded study, and HAVIT was involved in it. Results vary by individual.

### 1. AI Body Composition Analysis: Analyze Your Body Without Any Equipment, Then Track Your Way to Your Goal Weight in Numbers

![AI body composition analysis: ① Analyze → ② Set number-based goals → ③ Track toward your goal weight](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-1-analysis.webp)

HAVIT asks for your height and weight, plus a few questions about your build and daily habits. From your answers it estimates your skeletal muscle mass and body fat mass, then analyzes your body type based on your muscle-to-fat balance (free). A scale alone can't tell you whether you lost fat or muscle. These are estimates, not InBody or DEXA measurements. Knowing the difference matters even more if you're on a GLP-1 medication like Wegovy or Zepbound. Lean mass has been reported to make up **40–60%** of weight lost in some trials and **15% or less** in others (Neeland 2024).

Based on your analysis, HAVIT sets **10 daily goals** in numbers. They cover:
- a calorie intake that never drops below your basal metabolic rate
- protein, carbs, fat, and fiber
- calories burned and steps
- sleep, water, and weigh-ins

The logging screen shows at a glance how close each meal gets you to your calorie and nutrient goals (macro analysis per meal and per day is HAVIT Premium).

### 2. AI Coach and 12-Week Method: 1:1 Feedback on Every Log

![1:1 coaching from the AI coach, plus a 12-week curriculum and healthy routines tailored to your plan](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-2-coach.webp)

Every time you log, the AI coach HAVI tells you how you're tracking against today's goals and which nutrients you're short on. Then it suggests what to add at your next meal. Most calorie counters stop at the numbers. HAVIT keeps going.

**You start by building your plan in a conversation.** HAVI asks about your goals, whether you're on a GLP-1 and any side effects, and body details like height and weight. From your answers, it creates a **Body Blueprint** that sums up where your body is now, along with a goal plan.

**Every day, HAVI looks past calories to the rest of your logs.** Most calorie apps only look at what you ate. HAVI reviews your meal logs alongside your weight, water, sleep, steps, fasting, menstrual cycle, mood, and GLP-1 logs. A 1-minute check-in helps you map out the day together (daily check-ins are HAVIT Premium). Say you're staying within your calories, but you snack more the day after a short night's sleep. HAVI will point out that connection before telling you to cut calories further.

**You can ask with a photo.** Stuck between two snacks at the grocery store, or scanning a restaurant menu? Send a photo and ask which is the better pick. Free members have a daily chat limit, and HAVIT Premium makes it unlimited. At 10 pm, an **evening recap** wraps up your day, and you can leave a **one-line goal** for tomorrow (HAVIT Premium).

The team spent years supporting members in person at Juvis Diet. That experience taught them that sticking with logging over the long run matters more than hitting your calories exactly, so the app is built around consistency.

- **A 12-week program.** Each of the 12 stages has missions. Completion isn't self-reported. It's checked against your actual logs, like meals and steps.
- **Miss a day and keep your streak.** For missions that run several days in a row, your first miss is forgiven, a saver covers the second, and the third resets the mission. HAVIT Premium gives you 2 savers every week.

### 3. Tracking and Health Content: From GLP-1, Meals, and Sleep to Workouts, Meditation, and Articles

![The AI coach analyzes every log, and workouts, meditations, and articles help you learn and put it into practice](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-3-records.webp)

**Calories per meal are free.** Search for a food or enter it manually, and your calories add up meal by meal. The **AI food scan**, which estimates the dish, its calories, and its nutrients from a single photo, is HAVIT Premium.

**The AI food scan is an estimate, too.** A photo can't show how much oil or sauce went into a dish. Use it to make sure home-cooked meals with lots of different dishes don't go unlogged. When the oil or portion sizes differ from usual, adjust them by hand.

Sleep, water, fasting, menstrual cycle, and GLP-1 tracking are all free. HAVI comments on each one as you log:
- **Sleep:** HAVI looks at how consistent your bedtime is, not just how long you slept.
- **Water:** it shows which times of day you tend to fall short.
- **Menstrual cycle:** you log symptoms along with your cycle, and coaching adjusts to where you are in it.
- **GLP-1:** you can set up a dosing schedule and reminders, then view them alongside your weight changes.
- **Running:** distance, time, and pace are tracked in real time, and you can see them on your lock screen.

The same app also has workout videos by category and **6 guided meditation types**: breathing and relaxation, sleep, stress and anxiety relief, appetite and craving control, focus, and gratitude (HAVIT Premium). They come in handy when your hunger is emotional.

### 4. Habits That Stick Like a Game

![Logs turn into rewards and friendly competition: streaks, steps, and coins → challenges, rankings, and characters](/blog/havit/flow/en/havit-4-game.webp)

Logging your steps, meals, and sleep earns coins. You can compete with friends in challenges and rankings, and use your coins to dress up your character. Every log turns into an instant reward, so you'll want to open the app every day even without anyone cheering you on.

- **Stay motivated like it's a game.** There are streaks, coins for steps, challenges and badges, and rankings.

faq.question: What is the best Shotsy alternative in 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on your gap. For a pure shot tracker, MeAgain and Pep are close peers. If you want body composition, habit-building, and an AI coach alongside dose logging, an all-in-one wellness app like HAVIT fits better. Match the app to your biggest need — tracking, or whole-journey support.

faq.question: Is Shotsy a good GLP-1 tracker?
faq.answer: Yes. Shotsy does its core job well: one-tap dose logging, a visual injection-site rotation map, dose-linked side-effect logs, reminders, and 2026 support for oral GLP-1 pills. If a focused shot tracker is all you need, it's a solid choice.

faq.question: Does Shotsy track body composition or muscle mass?
faq.answer: No. Shotsy tracks weight, but not muscle vs fat. Because the lean-mass share of GLP-1 weight loss has reached 40–60% in some trials, a body-composition view is where an all-in-one app adds real value over a shot-only tracker.

faq.question: Is Shotsy free?
faq.answer: Shotsy's core features are free, with some advanced features behind a premium subscription (commonly around $49.99/year). Verify current pricing in the App Store or Google Play before subscribing.

faq.question: Does Shotsy have an AI coach?
faq.answer: No. Shotsy's reminders are scheduled, not conversational. If you want an assistant that reacts to your protein, side effects, and patterns and suggests the next small step, look for an app with an adaptive AI coach.

faq.question: Shotsy vs MeAgain — which is better?
faq.answer: Both are strong GLP-1 trackers. Shotsy is clean and focused on the shot; MeAgain has a broader all-in-one feature set and RDN-reviewed nutrition. Neither centers body composition or behavior change the way an all-in-one wellness app does — choose by which gap matters most to you.

faq.question: Can I switch apps mid-journey?
faq.answer: Yes, but consistency matters more than the app. Switch only if a specific gap — body composition, habits, coaching, or language — is actively hurting your consistency. Otherwise, the tool you'll open every day is the right one.

faq.question: Do these apps replace medical advice?
faq.answer: No. Shotsy, HAVIT, and every app here are tracking tools, not clinicians. "Estimated medication-level" views are educational approximations, not measurements. Follow your prescriber and pharmacist, and use your tracker to bring better data to appointments.

faq.question: Is HAVIT better than Shotsy?
faq.answer: It depends on what you are tracking. Shotsy is built for general calorie and nutrition logging. HAVIT is built around a GLP-1 course — dose and injection-site logging, side-effect patterns tied to injection timing, body composition, and protein intake to protect lean mass. If you are on a GLP-1, HAVIT covers what a general tracker leaves out; if you only need calorie counting, Shotsy is enough.

faq.question: What does HAVIT do that Shotsy doesn't?
faq.answer: Dose and injection-site rotation, side effects logged against injection timing, body-composition trend tracking, and habit coaching that adapts to your own logged data. HAVIT combines medication management and behavior change in one place instead of splitting them across apps.

faq.question: Can I switch from Shotsy to HAVIT?
faq.answer: Yes. Most people run both for a week or two — keep logging where you are comfortable while you set up your GLP-1 course in HAVIT — then move over once dose reminders and side-effect history are in place. Nothing about your prescription changes; HAVIT is a tracking companion, not a medical device.

*의학적 고지: 이 글은 교육 목적의 정보이며 의학적 조언·진단·용량 지시가 아닙니다. GLP-1 약물은 심각한 위험이 있을 수 있는 전문의약품입니다. 용량과 사용법은 반드시 처방 의사·약사의 지시를 따르고, 앱 화면을 근거로 스스로 용량을 바꾸지 마세요.*

'Shotsy 대안'을 검색했다면, 전용 GLP-1 트래커라는 아이디어 자체는 마음에 드는데 더 잘 맞는 앱이 있는지 궁금한 경우가 많습니다. 주사 기록을 넘어 체성분, 습관 만들기, 그리고 첫 주가 지나도 꾸준함을 지켜 주는 코칭까지 원할 수 있죠. 이 글은 특정 앱을 파는 광고가 아니라 중립적인 비교입니다. Shotsy는 정말 좋은 앱이고, 무엇을 잘하는지와 올인원 웰니스 앱이 어디서 앞서는지를 솔직하게 짚습니다.

## Shotsy가 잘하는 것

Shotsy는 주 1회(또는 매일) GLP-1 용량을 중심으로 설계됐고, 그 일을 깔끔하게 해냅니다.

### 원탭 용량 기록과 진짜 주사 부위 지도

주사나 알약을 한 번의 탭으로 기록하고 전체 투약 이력을 남깁니다. Shotsy는 **부위를 번갈아 놓도록 안내하는 시각적 바디맵**을 제공합니다. 같은 곳에 계속 놓으면 멍울·자극이 생길 수 있어, 이 기능이야말로 전용 트래커와 '칼로리 앱 개조판'을 가르는 핵심입니다([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### 스마트 알림과 다음 주사 카운트다운

주 1회 주사나 매일 경구 복용에 맞춰 정확한 일정을 설정하고, 카운트다운과 다음 투약 알림으로 잊지 않게 도와줍니다.

### 용량과 연결되는 부작용 기록

메스꺼움·두통·피로 같은 증상을 특정 용량·부위·식사와 연결해 기록할 수 있습니다. GLP-1 사용자의 40~70%가 위장관계 부작용을 겪기에 유용한 기능입니다([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### 폭넓은 약물 지원과 2026년 업데이트

Shotsy는 오젬픽, 위고비(주사·알약), 마운자로, 젭바운드, 리벨서스, 삭센다 등을 지원합니다. 버전 3.0(2026년 3월)은 **경구 GLP-1 알약 기록**과 목표 체중 도달자를 위한 **유지 모드(Maintenance Mode)**를 추가했고, 영양·단백질·수분 기록과 Apple Health 연동도 제공합니다([App Store의 Shotsy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## 올인원 사용자에게 Shotsy가 아쉬운 지점

이건 Shotsy를 깎아내리는 얘기가 아닙니다. 핵심 기능을 잘하는 집중형 도구죠. 다만 '좋은 주사 트래커'와 'GLP-1 여정 전체 관리'는 다른 일입니다.

### 1. 체성분(근육 대 지방) 뷰가 없음

GLP-1 체중 감량은 지방만 빠지는 게 아닙니다. GLP-1 치료로 줄어든 체중 중 **제지방 비율은 연구에 따라 40~60%에서 15% 이하까지 갈립니다**([Neeland 외, *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy는 체중을 기록하지만 근육 대 지방을 보여 주진 않습니다. '제대로 된 체중'을 빼고 있는지 알려 주는 숫자죠.

### 2. 기록이지, 행동 변화는 아님

Shotsy는 일어난 일을 기록합니다. 정작 어려운 문제—부작용이 심한 주간을 버티고 약이 끝나도 남는 습관을 만드는 일—는 근거 기반 지침이 강조하는 부분입니다. 미국 예방서비스특별위원회(USPSTF)는 비만 성인에게 다요소 **행동 중재**를 권고합니다([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). 트래커는 기록할 뿐, 코칭하지는 않습니다.

### 3. 적응형 AI 코치가 없음

Shotsy의 알림은 예약형이지 대화형이 아닙니다. 단백질·부작용·패턴에 반응해 다음 작은 행동을 제안하는 비서를 원한다면 다른 종류의 제품이 필요합니다.

### 4. 단일 목적 도구

식사·단백질·체성분·걸음·습관까지 함께 관리하려면 Shotsy에 두세 개의 앱을 덧붙이게 됩니다. 올인원은 이를 한곳에 모읍니다.

## 비교표: Shotsy vs 올인원 GLP-1 앱

GLP-1은 투여 일정과 알림을 설정할 수 있고, 체중 변화와 나란히 볼 수 있습니다.

러닝은 거리·시간·페이스를 실시간으로 기록하고 잠금 화면에서도 확인할 수 있습니다.

faq.answer: 됩니다. 다만 앱보다 꾸준함이 더 중요합니다. 체성분·습관·코칭·언어처럼 특정 부족함이 꾸준함을 실제로 해칠 때만 바꾸세요. 매일 여는 앱이 결국 맞는 앱입니다.

faq.question: 이 앱들이 의학적 조언을 대신하나요?
faq.answer: 아니요. Shotsy·HAVIT를 포함한 모든 앱은 기록 도구일 뿐 임상의가 아닙니다. '예상 약물 농도' 뷰는 측정이 아니라 교육용 근사치입니다. 처방의·약사의 지시를 따르고, 앱은 진료 때 더 나은 데이터를 가져가는 용도로 쓰세요.

faq.question: 하비트가 Shotsy보다 나은가요?
faq.answer: 무엇을 기록하려는지에 따라 다릅니다. Shotsy는 일반적인 칼로리·영양 기록에 맞춰져 있고, 하비트는 GLP-1 치료 과정을 축으로 설계됐습니다 — 용량·주사 부위 기록, 주사 시점과 연결된 부작용 패턴, 체성분, 제지방 보호를 위한 단백질 섭취까지 다룹니다. GLP-1을 쓰는 중이라면 일반 트래커가 놓치는 부분을 하비트가 메우고, 칼로리만 세면 된다면 Shotsy로 충분합니다.

faq.question: Shotsy에는 없고 하비트에만 있는 기능은 무엇인가요?
faq.answer: 용량·주사 부위 로테이션, 주사 타이밍에 붙는 부작용 기록, 체성분 추세, 그리고 기록한 데이터에 맞춰 조정되는 습관 코칭입니다. 약물 관리와 행동 변화를 앱 두 개로 쪼개지 않고 한 곳에서 다룹니다.

faq.question: Shotsy에서 하비트로 갈아탈 수 있나요?
faq.answer: 가능합니다. 보통 1~2주는 둘을 함께 쓰면서 익숙한 쪽에 계속 기록하고, 하비트에 GLP-1 일정을 세팅합니다. 용량 알림과 부작용 이력이 쌓이면 그때 옮기면 됩니다. 처방은 그대로이며 하비트는 기록을 돕는 동반 앱이지 의료기기가 아닙니다.

zh-CN.meta_description: 正在使用 Ozempic 或 Zepbound 并寻找 Shotsy 替代品?了解 Shotsy 注射追踪器的优势、局限,以及一体化 GLP-1 应用的对比。
zh-CN.tldr: 正在使用 Ozempic 或 Zepbound 并寻找 Shotsy 替代品?了解 Shotsy 注射追踪器的优势、局限,以及一体化 GLP-1 应用的对比。
zh-CN.body_md:
*医疗免责声明:本文仅供一般教育用途,不构成医疗建议、诊断或用药指导。GLP-1 药物是处方药,具有严重的潜在风险。请始终遵循处方医生的指示和 FDA 批准的标签说明,切勿根据应用程序更改剂量。*

如果你搜索'Shotsy 替代品',你可能已经喜欢专用 GLP-1 追踪器的理念 — 只是想知道是否有更适合你旅程的选择。也许你想要的不仅仅是注射记录:身体成分、习惯养成,以及能让你在第一周之后保持坚持的指导。这是一次诚实、供应商中立的对比。Shotsy 确实是一款优秀的应用;我们会明确说明它的优势以及一体化健康应用在哪些方面更胜一筹。

## Shotsy 的优势

Shotsy 围绕每周(或每日)GLP-1 剂量构建,并且出色地完成了这项工作。

### 一键剂量记录和真实的注射部位地图

一键记录注射或口服药物,并保留完整的用药历史。Shotsy 提供**可视化身体地图来轮换注射部位** — 这是专用追踪器与改装的卡路里应用的区别所在,因为反复在同一部位注射可能导致硬块或刺激([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/))。

### 智能提醒和下次剂量倒计时

为每周注射或每日口服剂量设置精确时间表,配有倒计时和下次剂量通知,这样每周一次的注射就不会被遗忘。

### 与剂量关联的副作用记录

可自定义的副作用日志让你记录恶心、头痛或疲劳,并将它们与特定剂量、部位或餐食关联 — 这很有用,因为 40-70% 的 GLP-1 用户会经历胃肠道副作用([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates))。

### 广泛的药物支持和 2026 年更新

Shotsy 支持 Ozempic、Wegovy(注射和口服)、Mounjaro、Zepbound、Rybelsus、Saxenda 等。3.0 版本(2026 年 3 月)新增了**口服 GLP-1 药片追踪**和**维持模式**(适用于达到目标体重的用户),以及营养、蛋白质和水分记录,并支持 Apple Health 同步([Shotsy on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249))。

## Shotsy 对一体化用户的不足之处

这些都不是对 Shotsy 的批评 — 它是一个专注的工具,出色地完成了核心工作。但'优秀的注射追踪器'和'管理整个 GLP-1 旅程'是不同的任务。以下是差距所在。

### 1. 没有身体成分视图

GLP-1 减重不仅仅是脂肪。**在一些试验中,GLP-1 治疗减掉的体重中瘦体重占比从 40-60% 到 15% 或更低不等**([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728))。Shotsy 追踪体重,但不能帮你看到肌肉与脂肪的对比 — 这个数字能告诉你是否在减掉*正确的*体重。

### 2. 记录而非行为改变

Shotsy 记录已发生的事情。更难的问题 — 在副作用周期间保持坚持并建立超越药物的习惯 — 正是领先指南实际呼吁的:USPSTF 建议对肥胖成年人进行密集的、多组分**行为**干预([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions))。追踪器记录;它不提供指导。

### 3. 没有自适应 AI 教练

Shotsy 的提醒是预设的,而非对话式的。如果你想要一个能对你的蛋白质摄入、副作用和模式做出反应的助手 — 并推动下一个小步骤 — 那是另一种产品。

### 4. 它是单一用途工具

如果你还追踪食物、蛋白质、身体成分、步数和习惯,你可能需要将 Shotsy 与其他两三个应用拼接在一起。一体化应用将所有内容集中在一处。

## 对比表:Shotsy vs 一体化 GLP-1 应用

*功能和价格经常变化 — 在承诺之前请在 App Store 或 Google Play 中验证。来源:[Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)、[Shotsy App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)。*

## 谁应该继续使用 Shotsy — 谁应该切换

**继续使用 Shotsy 如果:**你想要一个简洁、专注的注射追踪器;注射部位地图和剂量提醒是你的首要需求;并且你已经在其他地方追踪食物或不需要追踪。

**考虑替代品如果:**你想要身体成分(肌肉 vs 脂肪)、围绕注射的习惯养成和指导、AI 助手,或一个应用而非三个 — 或者你更喜欢韩语、日语或繁体中文的体验。

## 在 Shotsy 替代品中寻找什么

1. **剂量 + 引导式注射部位轮换** — Shotsy 已经完美实现的不可妥协的核心功能。
2. **身体成分** — 肌肉 vs 脂肪,而不仅仅是体重秤数字,这样你可以保护瘦体重。
3. **蛋白质优先的食物记录** — GLP-1 会降低食欲;蛋白质摄入不足会导致肌肉流失风险。
4. **习惯和行为改变支持** — 让你坚持数月的部分。
5. **自适应教练** — 根据你的数据做出响应的指导,而不仅仅是预设提醒。
6. **隐私** — 大多数美国健康应用不受 HIPAA 保护;优先选择具有明确导出/删除控制的应用。

## 结论

Shotsy 是对任何想要专用 GLP-1 注射追踪器的人的有力、诚实推荐 — 注射部位地图和提醒确实很好。差距在于注射*周围*的一切:身体成分、习惯和指导。如果你想要药物记录**以及**肌肉、习惯和 AI 教练集于一处,一体化应用是更好的 Shotsy 替代品。

如果这就是你,**[试用 HAVIT 应用](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — 剂量记录、蛋白质优先的食物追踪、身体成分、习惯养成和 AI 教练,旨在让你一周接一周地保持坚持。

## HAVIT：一个App，不只管饮食、营养和热量，更管好整个健康生活方式

GLP-1 药物可以显著减轻体重 — 但体重秤只是故事的一部分。GLP-1 治疗减掉的体重中瘦体重占比在一些试验中从 40-60% 到 15% 或更低不等 — 瘦体重包括器官、骨骼和体液,而不仅仅是肌肉([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)),并且一旦停药,效果往往会消退,除非新习惯取而代之 — 这就是为什么 USPSTF 建议密集的、多组分行为干预([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions))。

**HAVIT是一款AI减重教练App，由来自韩国领先减重诊所之一「Juvis Diet」的专家打造。** 它不只记录饮食、营养和热量，还把体成分、睡眠、运动和情绪一并纳入，用一个App管好你的整个健康生活方式。诊所里由专人一对一陪伴的「身体分析 → 用数字设定目标 → 每天教练指导」这一套流程，现在在App里就能完成。

**临床研究结果如下。** 在与乙支大学合作的12周临床研究中，体重减少5%以上的人数占比，HAVIT使用组为**31.7%**，对照组为8.1%（约**3.9倍**）；体脂率下降的人数占比为**83%**（对照组49%）。这项研究于2026年6～8月进行，分析了第1周和第12周均有InBody数据的78人（HAVIT组41人、对照组37人），为非盲研究，且有HAVIT参与。效果因人而异。

| | |
| --- | --- |
| 开发商 | Havit Inc. |
| 打造团队 | 来自韩国领先减重诊所之一Juvis Diet的专家 |
| 临床研究 | 与乙支大学合作的12周临床研究（78人，非盲） |
| 免费 | 饮食记录（搜索、手动输入）及每餐热量；体重、饮水、睡眠、步数、断食、心情、生理周期、GLP-1记录；体成分估算；与AI教练聊天（每天次数有上限） |
| HAVIT Premium | 每餐及全天三大营养素（蛋白质、脂肪、碳水化合物）分析、剩余热量、AI拍照识食、无限次聊天、每日签到、运动视频、引导式冥想、文章、每周2张补签卡（保住连续记录的道具）、晚间回顾和一句话目标 |
| App Store | 4.7（美国171条、韩国282条评分，2026年11月查询） |

免费与Premium的功能范围以2026年10月时App的默认设置为准。部分Premium功能可能会在活动期间免费开放。

### 1. AI体成分分析：无需仪器即可分析，用数字管理到目标体重

![AI体成分分析：① 分析 → ② 用数字定目标 → ③ 管理到目标体重](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-1-analysis.webp)

只需输入身高、体重，再回答几个关于体型和生活习惯的问题，就能估算骨骼肌量和体脂肪量，并根据肌肉与脂肪的比例分析出你的体型类型（免费）。因为光看体重秤上的数字，根本分不清「减掉的是脂肪还是肌肉」。这里给出的是估算值，并非InBody或DEXA的测量值。如果你正在使用Wegovy（司美格鲁肽）、Zepbound（替尔泊肽）等GLP-1类药物，这一点就更重要了。据报道，减掉的体重中去脂体重的占比在部分试验中达**40～60%**，在另一些试验中则为**15%以下**（Neeland 2024）。

根据分析结果，HAVIT会用数字为你设定**每日10项目标**：不低于基础代谢的摄入热量，蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪、膳食纤维，消耗热量、步数，以及睡眠、饮水、称重。在记录页面，每餐的热量和各项营养素完成到哪一步，一眼就能看清（每餐及全天三大营养素分析为HAVIT Premium功能）。

### 2. AI教练与12周方法：每天的记录都有1对1点评

![AI教练1对1指导，以及按计划划分的12周课程与健康日常](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-2-coach.webp)

每次记录后，AI教练HAVI都会告诉你今天离目标还差多少、缺了哪些营养，并建议下一餐该补点什么。不是记个数字就完事——这正是它和普通热量计算App的不同之处。

**一开始，先通过对话制定计划。** HAVI会问你的目标、是否在用GLP-1及有无副作用、身高体重等身体信息，再根据你的回答生成一份概括当前身体状况的**身体蓝图**和目标计划。

**每天连热量之外的记录也一起看。** 一般的热量App只看你吃了什么。HAVI会把饮食记录和体重、饮水、睡眠、步数、断食、生理周期、心情、GLP-1记录放在一起看，再用1分钟签到和你一起定好今天的计划（每日签到为HAVIT Premium功能）。比如热量明明在目标之内，但偏偏每次睡不够的第二天零食就变多——这时HAVI不会急着让你再少吃点，而是先帮你指出这层关联。

**还能拍照咨询。** 在便利店纠结两样东西，或者外出就餐看着菜单拿不定主意时，拍张照发过去，问问哪个更好。免费用户每天的聊天次数有上限，HAVIT Premium则不限次数。每晚10点，你会收到一份总结当天的**晚间回顾**，还可以为明天留下一条**一句话目标**（HAVIT Premium）。

基于在Juvis Diet直接陪伴会员的经验，HAVIT更看重的不是把热量算得分毫不差，而是让你能长久坚持记录下去。

- **12周课程。** 12个阶段各有任务，是否完成不靠自己打勾，而是根据饮食、步数等记录来判定。
- **漏了一天也能接上。** 需要连续几天的任务，漏掉第1次可以通融，第2次用补签卡接上，第3次才需要重新开始。HAVIT Premium每周发放2张补签卡。

### 3. 记录管理与健康内容：从GLP-1、饮食、睡眠到运动、冥想、文章

![每条记录都有AI教练分析，再通过运动、冥想、文章边学边练](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-3-records.webp)

**每餐热量记录免费。** 搜索食物或手动输入，每餐的热量就会自动累计。只需一张照片就能估算出菜品及其热量、营养素的**AI拍照识食**为HAVIT Premium功能。

**AI拍照识食也是估算。** 照片拍不出油和酱汁用了多少。建议把它当作防止漏记的工具，尤其是一桌好几道菜的家常饭；如果油量或米饭量和平时不一样，记得手动调整。

睡眠、饮水、断食、生理周期、GLP-1记录均免费。每记录一项，HAVI都会给出点评。睡眠不只看时长，还会看入睡时间是否规律；饮水会看哪个时段喝得不够。生理周期可以连同身体感受一起记录，并收到配合周期的教练建议。

GLP-1可以设置用药日程和提醒，并和体重变化放在一起对照查看。

跑步时可实时记录距离、时间、配速，锁屏界面也能查看。

同一个App里还有分类运动视频，以及**6种引导式冥想**（呼吸放松／助眠／缓解压力和焦虑／管理食欲和嘴馋／专注力／感恩）（HAVIT Premium）。当饥饿感其实来自情绪时，也能派上用场。

### 4. 像玩游戏一样养成习惯

![记录变成奖励和竞赛：连续记录、步数、金币 → 挑战、排行榜、角色](/blog/havit/flow/zh/havit-4-game.webp)

记录步数、饮食、睡眠就能攒金币，通过挑战和排行榜与好友一较高下，还能用金币给角色换装。即使没人督促，也会想每天打开App——因为每一次记录都能马上换来奖励。

- **像玩游戏一样坚持下去。** 有连续记录、按步数发放的金币、挑战与徽章，还有排行榜。

es.body_md:
*Aviso médico: Este artículo es solo para educación general y no constituye asesoramiento médico, diagnóstico ni orientación sobre dosificación. Los medicamentos GLP-1 son fármacos de prescripción con riesgos potenciales graves. Siempre sigue las instrucciones de tu médico prescriptor y la etiqueta aprobada por la FDA, y nunca cambies tu dosis basándote en una aplicación.*

Si buscaste una 'alternativa a Shotsy', probablemente ya te gusta la idea de un rastreador dedicado a GLP-1 — solo quieres saber si algo se ajusta mejor a tu proceso. Tal vez quieres más que un registro de inyecciones: composición corporal, construcción de hábitos y coaching que te mantenga constante más allá de la primera semana. Esta es una comparación honesta y neutral. Shotsy es genuinamente una buena app; seremos claros sobre qué hace bien y dónde una app de bienestar todo-en-uno se destaca.

## Qué hace bien Shotsy

Shotsy está construida en torno a la dosis semanal (o diaria) de GLP-1, y hace ese trabajo de manera limpia.

### Registro de dosis con un toque y un mapa real de sitios de inyección

Registra una inyección o una píldora con un solo toque y mantén un historial completo de medicación. Shotsy te ofrece un **mapa corporal visual para rotar los sitios de inyección** — la característica que separa un rastreador especializado de una app de calorías adaptada, porque inyectar repetidamente en el mismo lugar puede causar bultos o irritación ([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### Recordatorios inteligentes y cuentas regresivas para la próxima dosis

Establece horarios precisos para inyecciones semanales o dosis orales diarias, con cuentas regresivas y notificaciones de próxima dosis para que una inyección semanal no se te pase.

### Registro de efectos secundarios vinculados a tu dosis

Registros personalizables de efectos secundarios te permiten anotar náuseas, dolores de cabeza o fatiga y asociarlos con una dosis, sitio o comida específicos — útil porque el 40–70% de los usuarios de GLP-1 experimentan efectos secundarios gastrointestinales ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### Amplio soporte de medicamentos y actualizaciones 2026

Shotsy cubre Ozempic, Wegovy (inyección y píldora), Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda y más. La versión 3.0 (marzo 2026) agregó **rastreo de píldoras orales GLP-1** y un **Modo de Mantenimiento** para usuarios que alcanzaron su peso objetivo, además de registro de nutrición, proteína y agua, y sincronización con Apple Health ([Shotsy en App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## Dónde Shotsy se queda corta para usuarios todo-en-uno

Nada de esto es una crítica a Shotsy — es una herramienta enfocada que hace bien su trabajo principal. Pero 'excelente rastreador de inyecciones' y 'gestiona todo tu proceso con GLP-1' son trabajos diferentes. Aquí está la brecha.

### 1. Sin vista de composición corporal

La pérdida de peso con GLP-1 no es solo grasa. **La proporción de masa magra del peso perdido con terapia GLP-1 ha variado del 40–60% en algunos ensayos a 15% o menos en otros** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy rastrea el peso, pero no te ayuda a ver músculo vs. grasa — el número que te dice si estás perdiendo el peso *correcto*.

### 2. Registro, no cambio de comportamiento

Shotsy registra lo que sucedió. El problema más difícil — mantenerte constante durante las semanas de efectos secundarios y construir hábitos que duren más que el medicamento — es lo que la orientación líder realmente recomienda: el USPSTF recomienda intervenciones **conductuales** intensivas y multicomponente para adultos con obesidad ([USPSTF, Grado B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). Un rastreador registra; no entrena.

### 3. Sin coach de IA adaptativo

Los recordatorios de Shotsy están programados, no son conversacionales. Si quieres un asistente que reaccione a tu proteína, tus efectos secundarios y tus patrones — y te impulse al siguiente pequeño paso — eso es un producto diferente.

### 4. Es una herramienta de un solo propósito

Si también rastreas comida, proteína, composición corporal, pasos y hábitos, probablemente unirás Shotsy con otras dos o tres apps. Una todo-en-uno lo mantiene en un solo lugar.

## Quién debería quedarse con Shotsy — y quién debería cambiar

**Quédate con Shotsy si:** quieres un rastreador de inyecciones limpio y enfocado; el mapa de sitios de inyección y los recordatorios de dosis son tu máxima prioridad; y ya rastreas comida en otro lugar o no lo necesitas.

**Considera una alternativa si:** quieres composición corporal (músculo vs grasa), construcción de hábitos y coaching alrededor de la inyección, un asistente de IA, o una app en lugar de tres — o prefieres la experiencia en coreano, japonés o chino tradicional.

## Qué buscar en una alternativa a Shotsy

1. **Dosis + rotación guiada de sitios de inyección** — el núcleo no negociable que Shotsy ya domina.
2. **Composición corporal** — músculo vs grasa, no solo peso en la báscula, para proteger la masa magra.
3. **Registro de alimentos con prioridad en proteína** — el apetito disminuye con GLP-1; comer poca proteína arriesga pérdida muscular.
4. **Soporte de hábitos y cambio de comportamiento** — la parte que te mantiene constante durante meses.
5. **Un coach adaptativo** — orientación que responde a tus datos, no solo un recordatorio programado.
6. **Privacidad** — la mayoría de las apps de bienestar de EE.UU. no están cubiertas por HIPAA; prefiere controles claros de exportación/eliminación.

## La conclusión

Shotsy es una recomendación sólida y honesta para cualquiera que quiera un rastreador dedicado de inyecciones GLP-1 — el mapa de sitios de inyección y los recordatorios son genuinamente buenos. La brecha está en todo lo que rodea la inyección: composición corporal, hábitos y coaching. Si quieres el registro de medicación **y** el músculo, los hábitos y un coach de IA en un solo lugar, una todo-en-uno es la mejor alternativa a Shotsy.

Si ese eres tú, **[prueba la app HAVIT](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — registro de dosis, rastreo de alimentos con prioridad en proteína, composición corporal, construcción de hábitos y un coach de IA, construida para mantenerte constante semana tras semana.

## HAVIT: una sola app para cuidar no solo tu alimentación, nutrición y calorías, sino todo tu estilo de vida saludable

Los medicamentos GLP-1 pueden reducir significativamente el peso — pero la báscula es solo parte de la historia. La proporción de masa magra del peso perdido con terapia GLP-1 ha variado del 40–60% en algunos ensayos a 15% o menos en otros — y la masa magra cuenta órganos, hueso y líquido, no solo músculo ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), y los resultados tienden a desvanecerse una vez que el medicamento se detiene a menos que nuevos hábitos tomen su lugar — por eso el USPSTF recomienda intervenciones conductuales intensivas y multicomponente ([USPSTF, Grado B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT es una app de coach de dieta con IA, creada por especialistas que vienen de Juvis Diet, una de las principales clínicas de dieta de Corea.** No se queda en la alimentación, la nutrición y las calorías: también abarca composición corporal, sueño, ejercicio y bienestar emocional, todo en una sola app. Lleva a la app el mismo proceso que en la clínica se hacía con acompañamiento humano directo: "analizar el cuerpo → fijar metas con números → recibir coaching todos los días".

Además, el **83%** redujo su porcentaje de grasa corporal (49% en el grupo de control). Fue un estudio no ciego, realizado de junio a agosto de 2026, que analizó a 78 personas con resultados de InBody en la semana 1 y la semana 12 (HAVIT 41, grupo de control 37). pt-BR.body_md:
*Aviso médico: Este artigo é apenas para educação geral e não constitui aconselhamento médico, diagnóstico ou orientação de dosagem. Medicamentos GLP-1 são medicamentos prescritos com riscos potenciais sérios. Sempre siga as instruções do seu prescritor e a bula aprovada pela FDA, e nunca altere sua dose com base em um aplicativo.*

Se você procurou por uma 'alternativa ao Shotsy', provavelmente já gosta da ideia de um rastreador dedicado de GLP-1 — você só quer saber se existe algo que se encaixa melhor na sua jornada. Talvez você queira mais do que um registro de injeções: composição corporal, construção de hábitos e coaching que mantém você consistente além da primeira semana. Esta é uma comparação honesta e neutra. Shotsy é um aplicativo genuinamente bom; seremos claros sobre o que ele faz bem e onde um app de bem-estar completo se destaca.

## O Que o Shotsy Faz Bem

Shotsy é construído em torno da dose semanal (ou diária) de GLP-1, e faz esse trabalho de forma limpa.

### Registro de dose com um toque e um mapa real de locais de injeção

Registre uma injeção ou um comprimido com um único toque e mantenha um histórico completo de medicação. Shotsy oferece um **mapa visual do corpo para alternar locais de injeção** — o recurso que separa um rastreador feito sob medida de um app de calorias reaproveitado, porque injetar repetidamente no mesmo local pode causar nódulos ou irritação ([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### Lembretes inteligentes e contagem regressiva para a próxima dose

Defina horários precisos para injeções semanais ou doses orais diárias, com contagens regressivas e notificações da próxima dose para que uma injeção semanal não passe despercebida.

### Registro de efeitos colaterais vinculados à sua dose

Registros personalizáveis de efeitos colaterais permitem que você anote náusea, dores de cabeça ou fadiga e os associe a uma dose, local ou refeição específica — útil porque 40–70% dos usuários de GLP-1 experimentam efeitos colaterais gastrointestinais ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### Suporte amplo a medicamentos e atualizações de 2026

Shotsy cobre Ozempic, Wegovy (injeção e comprimido), Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda e mais. A versão 3.0 (março de 2026) adicionou **rastreamento de comprimidos orais de GLP-1** e um **Modo de Manutenção** para usuários no peso desejado, além de registro de nutrição, proteína e água e sincronização com Apple Health ([Shotsy na App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## Onde o Shotsy Fica Aquém para Usuários que Querem Tudo-em-Um

Nada disso é uma crítica ao Shotsy — é uma ferramenta focada que faz seu trabalho principal bem. Mas 'ótimo rastreador de injeções' e 'gerencia toda a sua jornada GLP-1' são trabalhos diferentes. Aqui está a lacuna.

### 1. Sem visualização de composição corporal

A perda de peso com GLP-1 não é apenas gordura. **A proporção de massa magra na perda de peso com terapia GLP-1 variou de 40–60% em alguns estudos a 15% ou menos em outros** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy rastreia peso, mas não ajuda você a ver músculo vs. gordura — o número que diz se você está perdendo o peso *certo*.

### 2. Registro, não mudança de comportamento

Shotsy registra o que aconteceu. O problema mais difícil — manter-se consistente durante semanas de efeitos colaterais e construir hábitos que durem além da medicação — é o que as orientações líderes realmente recomendam: a USPSTF recomenda intervenções **comportamentais** intensivas e multicomponentes para adultos com obesidade ([USPSTF, Grau B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). Um rastreador registra; ele não orienta.

### 3. Sem coach de IA adaptativo

Os lembretes do Shotsy são agendados, não conversacionais. Se você quer um assistente que reage à sua proteína, seus efeitos colaterais e seus padrões — e sugere o próximo pequeno passo — esse é um produto diferente.

### 4. É uma ferramenta de propósito único

Se você também rastreia comida, proteína, composição corporal, passos e hábitos, provavelmente vai juntar o Shotsy com dois ou três outros apps. Um app completo mantém tudo em um só lugar.

## Tabela Comparativa: Shotsy vs um App GLP-1 Completo

*Recursos e preços mudam frequentemente — verifique na App Store ou Google Play antes de se comprometer. Fontes: [Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/), [Shotsy App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249).*

## Quem Deve Continuar no Shotsy — e Quem Deve Mudar

**Fique no Shotsy se:** você quer um rastreador de injeções limpo e focado; o mapa de locais de injeção e lembretes de dose são sua prioridade máxima; e você já rastreia comida em outro lugar ou não precisa.

**Considere uma alternativa se:** você quer composição corporal (músculo vs gordura), construção de hábitos e coaching em torno da injeção, um assistente de IA, ou um app em vez de três — ou você prefere a experiência em coreano, japonês ou chinês tradicional.

## O Que Procurar em uma Alternativa ao Shotsy

1. **Dose + rotação guiada de locais de injeção** — o núcleo inegociável que o Shotsy já acerta.
2. **Composição corporal** — músculo vs gordura, não apenas peso na balança, para proteger massa magra.
3. **Registro de alimentos com foco em proteína** — o apetite cai com GLP-1; comer pouca proteína arrisca perda muscular.
4. **Suporte a hábitos e mudança de comportamento** — a parte que mantém você consistente por meses.
5. **Um coach adaptativo** — orientação que responde aos seus dados, não apenas um lembrete agendado.
6. **Privacidade** — a maioria dos apps de bem-estar dos EUA não são cobertos pela HIPAA; prefira controles claros de exportação/exclusão.

## A Conclusão

Shotsy é uma recomendação forte e honesta para quem quer um rastreador dedicado de injeções GLP-1 — o mapa de locais de injeção e os lembretes são genuinamente bons. A lacuna é tudo *em torno* da injeção: composição corporal, hábitos e coaching. Se você quer o registro de medicação **e** o músculo, os hábitos e um coach de IA em um só lugar, um app completo é a melhor alternativa ao Shotsy.

Se esse é você, **[experimente o app HAVIT](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — registro de dose, rastreamento de alimentos com foco em proteína, composição corporal, construção de hábitos e um coach de IA, construído para mantê-lo consistente uma semana de cada vez.

## HAVIT: um só app para cuidar não só de refeições, nutrientes e calorias, mas de todo o seu estilo de vida saudável

Medicamentos GLP-1 podem reduzir significativamente o peso — mas a balança é apenas parte da história. A proporção de massa magra na perda de peso com terapia GLP-1 variou de 40–60% em alguns estudos a 15% ou menos em outros — e massa magra inclui órgãos, ossos e fluidos, não apenas músculo ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), e os resultados tendem a desaparecer quando a medicação para, a menos que novos hábitos tomem seu lugar — é por isso que a USPSTF recomenda intervenções comportamentais intensivas e multicomponentes ([USPSTF, Grau B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**O HAVIT é um app de coach de dieta com IA criado por especialistas vindos da Juvis Diet, uma das principais clínicas de emagrecimento da Coreia.** Ele vai além do controle de refeições, nutrientes e calorias: composição corporal, sono, exercícios e bem-estar emocional também ficam no mesmo app, para você cuidar de todo o seu estilo de vida saudável. O processo que a clínica sempre conduziu com acompanhamento pessoal ("analisar o corpo → definir metas com números → orientar todos os dias") agora está dentro do app.

**Veja os resultados de um estudo clínico.** Em um estudo clínico de 12 semanas com a Universidade Eulji, **31,7%** das pessoas do grupo que usou o HAVIT perderam 5% ou mais do peso, contra 8,1% no grupo controle (cerca de **3,9x** mais). E **83%** reduziram o percentual de gordura corporal (49% no grupo controle). O estudo foi feito entre junho e agosto de 2026, não cego, e analisou 78 pessoas com resultados de InBody na semana 1 e na semana 12 (41 no HAVIT e 37 no grupo controle). É um estudo do qual o HAVIT participou. Os resultados variam de pessoa para pessoa.

### 1. Análise de composição corporal com IA: análise sem aparelho e metas com números até o peso desejado

![Análise de composição corporal com IA: ① análise → ② metas em números → ③ acompanhamento até o peso desejado](/blog/havit/flow/pt-br/havit-1-analysis.webp)

A partir da sua altura, do seu peso e de algumas perguntas sobre seu corpo e seus hábitos, o app estima sua massa muscular esquelética e sua massa de gordura, e analisa até o seu tipo corporal com base no equilíbrio entre músculo e gordura (grátis). Isso porque só o número da balança não mostra se você perdeu gordura ou músculo. São valores estimados, não medições de InBody ou DEXA. Se você usa GLP-1 (como Wegovy ou Mounjaro), isso importa ainda mais: a parcela de massa magra no peso perdido foi de **40–60%** em alguns estudos e de **15% ou menos** em outros (Neeland 2024).

Com base na análise, o app define com números **10 metas diárias**: calorias ingeridas sem ficar abaixo do seu metabolismo basal; proteínas, carboidratos, gorduras e fibras; calorias gastas e passos; e ainda sono, água e pesagem. Na tela de registro, você vê de relance o quanto já atingiu de calorias e nutrientes em cada refeição (a análise de macros por refeição e do dia é do HAVIT Premium).

### 2. Coach de IA e método de 12 semanas: comentários 1:1 sobre cada registro do dia

![Coaching 1:1 do coach de IA, currículo de 12 semanas por plano e rotinas saudáveis](/blog/havit/flow/pt-br/havit-2-coach.webp)

A cada registro, a HAVI, sua coach de IA, mostra como você está em relação às metas do dia e quais nutrientes estão faltando, e sugere o que acrescentar na próxima refeição. Ir além dos números é o que diferencia o HAVIT de um app comum de contar calorias.

**Tudo começa com uma conversa para montar o plano.** A HAVI pergunta seu objetivo, se você usa GLP-1 e quais efeitos colaterais sente, além de dados como altura e peso. Com essas respostas, ela monta o seu **Body Blueprint**, um resumo do estado atual do seu corpo, e o seu plano de metas.

**Todos os dias, ela olha além das calorias.** Apps de calorias costumam olhar só o que você comeu. A HAVI cruza o registro das refeições com peso, água, sono, passos, jejum, ciclo menstrual, humor e GLP-1, e define com você o plano do dia em um check-in de 1 minuto (o check-in diário é do HAVIT Premium). Por exemplo: se suas calorias estão dentro da meta, mas os beliscos aumentam justamente depois de noites mal dormidas, ela aponta essa ligação antes de mandar você cortar ainda mais calorias.

**Dá para pedir ajuda com foto.** Ficou em dúvida entre dois produtos no mercado ou entre opções do cardápio do restaurante? Mande uma foto e pergunte qual é a melhor escolha. No plano grátis há um limite diário de mensagens; no HAVIT Premium, o chat é ilimitado. Às 22h chega o **resumo da noite**, com um balanço do seu dia, e você pode deixar uma **meta para amanhã** (HAVIT Premium).

Com base na experiência da Juvis Diet no acompanhamento direto de clientes, o foco está menos em acertar as calorias com precisão e mais em criar um jeito de você manter os registros por muito tempo.

- **Programa de 12 semanas.** Cada uma das 12 etapas tem missões, e o cumprimento não depende do que você declara: ele é conferido pelos seus registros, como refeições e passos.
- **Um dia perdido não quebra a sequência.** Nas missões de vários dias seguidos, a primeira falha é perdoada, a segunda é coberta por um saver e só na terceira você recomeça. No HAVIT Premium, você recebe 2 savers por semana.

### 3. Registros e conteúdos de saúde: de GLP-1, refeições e sono a exercícios, meditação e artigos

![O coach de IA analisa cada registro, e você aprende e pratica com exercícios, meditações e artigos](/blog/havit/flow/pt-br/havit-3-records.webp)

**Calorias por refeição já estão no plano grátis.** Basta buscar o alimento ou digitar manualmente, e as calorias de cada refeição vão sendo somadas. O **escaneamento de comida por IA**, que estima o prato, as calorias e os nutrientes a partir de uma única foto, é do HAVIT Premium.

**O escaneamento por IA também é uma estimativa.** A foto não mostra quanto óleo ou molho foi usado. Use-o como uma ferramenta para não esquecer de registrar as refeições de casa, com arroz, feijão, salada e mistura no mesmo prato, e ajuste manualmente quando a quantidade de óleo ou de arroz for diferente do normal.

Os registros de sono, água, jejum, ciclo menstrual e GLP-1 são grátis, e a HAVI comenta cada um deles. No sono, ela olha não só as horas dormidas, mas também a variação no horário de dormir; na água, os períodos do dia em que você bebe pouco. O ciclo menstrual é registrado junto com os sintomas, e você recebe orientações de acordo com cada fase do ciclo.

Para o GLP-1, você pode configurar o calendário de aplicações e os lembretes, e acompanhar tudo lado a lado com a evolução do seu peso.

Na corrida, distância, tempo e ritmo são registrados em tempo real e aparecem até na tela de bloqueio.

O mesmo app traz vídeos de exercícios por categoria e **6 tipos de meditação guiada** (respiração e relaxamento / indução do sono / alívio do estresse e da ansiedade / controle do apetite e da vontade de comer / foco / gratidão) (HAVIT Premium). Eles ajudam também quando a fome vem das emoções.

### 4. Hábitos que se mantêm como num jogo

![Registros viram recompensa e competição: sequência, passos e moedas → desafios, ranking e personagem](/blog/havit/flow/pt-br/havit-4-game.webp)

Registrar passos, refeições e sono rende moedas; nos desafios e no ranking você compete com outras pessoas; e com as moedas dá para trocar o visual do seu personagem. O app foi pensado para que cada registro vire uma recompensa na hora, para você ter vontade de abri-lo todos os dias, mesmo sem ninguém te incentivando.

- **Constância com cara de jogo.** Sequência de registros, moedas por passos, desafios e medalhas, e ranking.

id.tldr: Mencari alternatif Shotsy saat menggunakan Ozempic atau Zepbound? Apa yang dilakukan pelacak suntikan Shotsy dengan baik, di mana batasannya, dan bagaimana aplikasi GLP-1 all-in-one dibandingkan.
id.body_md:
*Penafian medis: Artikel ini hanya untuk edukasi umum dan bukan nasihat medis, diagnosis, atau panduan dosis. Obat GLP-1 adalah obat resep dengan potensi risiko serius. Selalu ikuti instruksi dokter penulis resep Anda dan label yang disetujui FDA, dan jangan pernah mengubah dosis Anda berdasarkan aplikasi.*

Jika Anda mencari 'alternatif Shotsy', Anda mungkin sudah menyukai ide pelacak GLP-1 khusus — Anda hanya ingin tahu apakah ada yang lebih cocok untuk perjalanan Anda. Mungkin Anda menginginkan lebih dari sekadar catatan suntikan: komposisi tubuh, pembentukan kebiasaan, dan pendampingan yang membuat Anda konsisten melewati minggu pertama. Ini adalah perbandingan jujur dan netral. Shotsy adalah aplikasi yang benar-benar bagus; kami akan jelas tentang apa yang dilakukannya dengan baik dan di mana aplikasi wellness all-in-one lebih unggul.

## Apa yang Dilakukan Shotsy dengan Baik

Shotsy dibangun di sekitar dosis GLP-1 mingguan (atau harian), dan melakukan pekerjaan itu dengan baik.

### Pencatatan dosis satu ketukan dan peta lokasi suntikan yang nyata

Catat suntikan atau pil dalam satu ketukan dan simpan riwayat pengobatan lengkap. Shotsy memberi Anda **peta tubuh visual untuk merotasi lokasi suntikan** — fitur yang memisahkan pelacak khusus dari aplikasi kalori yang diubah fungsinya, karena menyuntik tempat yang sama berulang kali dapat menyebabkan benjolan atau iritasi ([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### Pengingat pintar dan hitung mundur dosis berikutnya

Atur jadwal yang tepat untuk suntikan mingguan atau dosis oral harian, dengan hitung mundur dan notifikasi dosis berikutnya sehingga suntikan sekali seminggu tidak terlewat.

### Pencatatan efek samping yang terkait dengan dosis Anda

Log efek samping yang dapat disesuaikan memungkinkan Anda mencatat mual, sakit kepala, atau kelelahan dan mengaitkannya dengan dosis, lokasi, atau makanan tertentu — berguna karena 40–70% pengguna GLP-1 mengalami efek samping GI ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### Dukungan obat yang luas dan pembaruan 2026

Shotsy mencakup Ozempic, Wegovy (suntikan dan pil), Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda, dan lainnya. Versi 3.0 (Maret 2026) menambahkan **pelacakan pil GLP-1 oral** dan **Mode Pemeliharaan** untuk pengguna yang mencapai berat badan target, ditambah pencatatan nutrisi, protein, dan air serta sinkronisasi Apple Health ([Shotsy di App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## Di Mana Shotsy Kurang untuk Pengguna All-in-One

Tidak ada dari ini yang merupakan kritik terhadap Shotsy — ini adalah alat yang fokus dan melakukan pekerjaan intinya dengan baik. Tetapi 'pelacak suntikan yang hebat' dan 'mengelola seluruh perjalanan GLP-1 Anda' adalah pekerjaan yang berbeda. Inilah kesenjangannya.

### 1. Tidak ada tampilan komposisi tubuh

Penurunan berat badan GLP-1 bukan hanya lemak. **Bagian massa tanpa lemak dari berat badan yang hilang pada terapi GLP-1 berkisar dari 40–60% dalam beberapa uji coba hingga 15% atau kurang pada yang lain** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy melacak berat badan, tetapi tidak membantu Anda melihat otot vs lemak — angka yang memberi tahu Anda apakah Anda kehilangan berat badan yang *tepat*.

### 2. Pencatatan, bukan perubahan perilaku

Shotsy mencatat apa yang terjadi. Masalah yang lebih sulit — tetap konsisten melalui minggu-minggu efek samping dan membangun kebiasaan yang bertahan lebih lama dari obat — adalah apa yang sebenarnya diminta oleh panduan terkemuka: USPSTF merekomendasikan intervensi **perilaku** intensif dan multikomponen untuk orang dewasa dengan obesitas ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). Pelacak mencatat; tidak melatih.

### 3. Tidak ada pelatih AI adaptif

Pengingat Shotsy dijadwalkan, bukan percakapan. Jika Anda menginginkan asisten yang bereaksi terhadap protein Anda, efek samping Anda, dan pola Anda — dan mendorong langkah kecil berikutnya — itu adalah produk yang berbeda.

### 4. Ini adalah alat satu tujuan

Jika Anda juga melacak makanan, protein, komposisi tubuh, langkah, dan kebiasaan, Anda mungkin akan menggabungkan Shotsy dengan dua atau tiga aplikasi lain. All-in-one menyimpannya di satu tempat.

## Tabel Perbandingan: Shotsy vs Aplikasi GLP-1 All-in-One

*Fitur dan harga sering berubah — verifikasi di App Store atau Google Play sebelum Anda berkomitmen. Sumber: [Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/), [Shotsy App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249).*

## Siapa yang Harus Tetap di Shotsy — dan Siapa yang Harus Beralih

**Tetap di Shotsy jika:** Anda menginginkan pelacak suntikan yang bersih dan fokus; peta lokasi suntikan dan pengingat dosis adalah prioritas utama Anda; dan Anda sudah melacak makanan di tempat lain atau tidak perlu.

**Pertimbangkan alternatif jika:** Anda menginginkan komposisi tubuh (otot vs lemak), pembentukan kebiasaan dan pendampingan seputar suntikan, asisten AI, atau satu aplikasi alih-alih tiga — atau Anda lebih suka pengalaman dalam bahasa Korea, Jepang, atau Tionghoa Tradisional.

## Apa yang Harus Dicari dalam Alternatif Shotsy

1. **Dosis + rotasi lokasi suntikan terpandu** — inti yang tidak dapat ditawar yang sudah dikuasai Shotsy.
2. **Komposisi tubuh** — otot vs lemak, bukan hanya berat timbangan, sehingga Anda melindungi massa tanpa lemak.
3. **Pencatatan makanan yang mengutamakan protein** — nafsu makan turun pada GLP-1; kurang makan protein berisiko kehilangan otot.
4. **Dukungan kebiasaan & perubahan perilaku** — bagian yang membuat Anda konsisten selama berbulan-bulan.
5. **Pelatih adaptif** — panduan yang merespons data Anda, bukan hanya ping terjadwal.
6. **Privasi** — sebagian besar aplikasi wellness AS tidak tercakup HIPAA; lebih suka kontrol ekspor/hapus yang jelas.

## Kesimpulan

Shotsy adalah rekomendasi yang kuat dan jujur untuk siapa pun yang menginginkan pelacak suntikan GLP-1 khusus — peta lokasi suntikan dan pengingat benar-benar bagus. Kesenjangannya adalah segala sesuatu *di sekitar* suntikan: komposisi tubuh, kebiasaan, dan pendampingan. Jika Anda menginginkan log obat **dan** otot, kebiasaan, dan pelatih AI di satu tempat, all-in-one adalah alternatif Shotsy yang lebih baik.

Jika itu Anda, **[coba aplikasi HAVIT](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — pencatatan dosis, pelacakan makanan yang mengutamakan protein, komposisi tubuh, pembentukan kebiasaan, dan pelatih AI, dibangun untuk membuat Anda konsisten satu minggu pada satu waktu.

## HAVIT: Satu aplikasi untuk mengelola makan, nutrisi, dan kalori, sekaligus seluruh gaya hidup sehat Anda

Obat GLP-1 dapat secara bermakna mengurangi berat badan — tetapi timbangan hanya bagian dari cerita. Bagian massa tanpa lemak dari berat badan yang hilang pada terapi GLP-1 berkisar dari 40–60% dalam beberapa uji coba hingga 15% atau kurang pada yang lain — dan massa tanpa lemak menghitung organ, tulang dan cairan, bukan hanya otot ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), dan hasilnya cenderung memudar setelah obat dihentikan kecuali kebiasaan baru menggantikannya — itulah mengapa USPSTF merekomendasikan intervensi perilaku intensif dan multikomponen ([USPSTF, Grade B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT adalah aplikasi pelatih diet AI yang dibuat oleh para ahli dari Juvis Diet, salah satu klinik diet terkemuka di Korea.** HAVIT tidak hanya mengelola makan, nutrisi, dan kalori. Komposisi tubuh, tidur, olahraga, hingga kesehatan mental juga diatur dalam satu aplikasi. Alur yang selama ini didampingi langsung oleh tenaga ahli di klinik, yaitu "analisis tubuh → tetapkan target dengan angka → coaching setiap hari", kini bisa Anda jalani lewat aplikasi.

**Berikut hasil studi klinisnya.** Dalam studi klinis 12 minggu bersama Universitas Eulji, **31,7%** pengguna HAVIT berhasil menurunkan berat badan 5% atau lebih, dibandingkan 8,1% pada kelompok kontrol (sekitar **3,9 kali** lipat). Proporsi peserta yang persentase lemak tubuhnya turun mencapai **83%** (kelompok kontrol 49%). Studi non-blinded ini dilakukan pada Juni–Agustus 2026 dan menganalisis 78 peserta yang memiliki hasil InBody minggu ke-1 dan ke-12 (HAVIT 41 orang, kelompok kontrol 37 orang). HAVIT terlibat dalam studi ini. Hasil dapat berbeda pada setiap orang.

Cakupan fitur Gratis dan Premium mengikuti pengaturan awal aplikasi per Oktober 2026. Sebagian fitur Premium kadang dibuka gratis saat ada promo atau kampanye.

### 1. Analisis komposisi tubuh AI: dianalisis tanpa alat, lalu dipantau dengan angka sampai berat target

![Analisis komposisi tubuh AI: ① Analisis → ② Target berupa angka → ③ Pantau berat target](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-1-analysis.webp)

Dari tinggi dan berat badan, ditambah beberapa pertanyaan soal bentuk tubuh dan kebiasaan sehari-hari, HAVIT memperkirakan massa otot rangka dan massa lemak. Dari keseimbangan otot dan lemak itu, tipe tubuh Anda juga dianalisis (gratis). Alasannya, angka di timbangan saja tidak bisa memberi tahu apakah yang turun itu lemak atau otot. Hasilnya berupa estimasi, bukan hasil pengukuran InBody atau DEXA. Kalau Anda memakai GLP-1 (misalnya Wegovy atau Mounjaro), hal ini makin penting. Proporsi massa bebas lemak dari total berat badan yang turun dilaporkan sebesar **40–60%** di sebagian uji klinis, dan **15% atau kurang** di uji lainnya (Neeland 2024).

Berdasarkan hasil analisis, HAVIT menetapkan **10 target harian** dalam bentuk angka: asupan kalori yang tidak di bawah metabolisme basal; protein, karbohidrat, lemak, dan serat; kalori terbakar dan jumlah langkah; serta tidur, minum air, dan penimbangan berat badan. Di layar catatan, Anda bisa melihat sekilas sejauh mana kalori dan nutrisi tiap waktu makan sudah tercapai (analisis makro per waktu makan dan per hari tersedia di HAVIT Premium).

### 2. Pelatih AI dan metode 12 minggu: komentar 1:1 untuk setiap catatan harian

![Coaching 1:1 dari pelatih AI, plus kurikulum 12 minggu dan rutinitas sehat sesuai program](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-2-coach.webp)

Setiap kali Anda mencatat, pelatih AI HAVI memberi tahu progres Anda terhadap target hari ini dan nutrisi apa yang masih kurang, lalu menyarankan apa yang perlu ditambahkan di waktu makan berikutnya. Aplikasi hitung kalori biasa berhenti di angka. HAVIT tidak.

**Awalnya, rencana disusun lewat percakapan.** HAVI menanyakan tujuan Anda, apakah Anda memakai GLP-1 dan efek sampingnya, serta data tubuh seperti tinggi dan berat badan. Dari jawaban itu, HAVI menyusun **Body Blueprint** yang merangkum kondisi tubuh Anda saat ini, beserta rencana target.

**Setiap hari, yang dicek bukan cuma kalori.** Aplikasi kalori umumnya hanya melihat apa yang Anda makan. HAVI mengecek catatan makan bersama catatan berat badan, minum air, tidur, langkah, puasa, siklus menstruasi, suasana hati, dan GLP-1, lalu menentukan rencana hari ini bersama Anda lewat check-in 1 menit (check-in harian tersedia di HAVIT Premium). Misalnya, kalori Anda masih dalam target, tapi camilan selalu bertambah setiap kali Anda kurang tidur malam sebelumnya. Sebelum menyuruh Anda memangkas kalori lagi, HAVI akan menunjukkan kaitan itu lebih dulu.

**Bisa berkonsultasi lewat foto.** Bingung memilih di antara dua produk di Indomaret atau Alfamart, atau memilih menu saat makan di luar? Kirim fotonya dan tanyakan mana yang lebih baik. Pengguna gratis punya batas jumlah chat per hari, sedangkan HAVIT Premium tanpa batas. Setiap pukul 10 malam, Anda menerima **rangkuman malam** tentang hari itu dan bisa menuliskan **target singkat** untuk besok (HAVIT Premium).

Dari pengalaman mendampingi langsung para member di Juvis Diet, HAVIT lebih menekankan cara agar Anda bisa terus mencatat dalam jangka panjang, bukan mencocokkan kalori sampai pas.

- **Program 12 minggu.** Program ini terdiri dari 12 tahap, masing-masing dengan misinya sendiri. Pencapaiannya dinilai dari catatan seperti makan dan jumlah langkah, bukan dari pengakuan sendiri.
- **Tetap tersambung meski ada hari yang bolong.** Untuk misi yang harus dijalani beberapa hari berturut-turut, bolong pertama masih dimaklumi, bolong kedua ditambal dengan saver, dan bolong ketiga membuat misi diulang dari awal. Pengguna HAVIT Premium mendapat 2 saver setiap minggu.

### 3. Pengelolaan catatan dan konten kesehatan: dari GLP-1, makan, dan tidur sampai olahraga, meditasi, dan artikel

![Pelatih AI menganalisis setiap catatan, lalu Anda belajar dan mempraktikkannya lewat olahraga, meditasi, dan artikel](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-3-records.webp)

**Kalori per waktu makan bisa dicatat gratis.** Cari makanan atau input manual, dan kalori per waktu makan akan dijumlahkan secara otomatis. **AI Food Scan**, yang memperkirakan jenis makanan, kalori, dan nutrisinya hanya dari satu foto, tersedia di HAVIT Premium.

**AI Food Scan juga hanya estimasi.** Jumlah minyak atau saus tidak kelihatan di foto. Pakai fitur ini supaya Anda tidak lupa mencatat makanan rumahan dengan banyak lauk, lalu koreksi manual kalau porsi minyak atau nasinya berbeda dari biasanya.

Catatan tidur, minum air, puasa, siklus menstruasi, dan GLP-1 gratis. HAVI memberi komentar untuk setiap catatan. Untuk tidur, yang dilihat bukan cuma durasinya, tapi juga jam tidur yang tidak teratur. Untuk minum air, HAVI melihat di jam berapa saja asupan Anda kurang. Siklus menstruasi dicatat bersama gejalanya, lalu Anda mendapat coaching yang disesuaikan dengan siklus.

Untuk GLP-1, Anda bisa mengatur jadwal pemakaian dan pengingat, lalu melihatnya berdampingan dengan perubahan berat badan.

Saat lari, jarak, waktu, dan pace tercatat secara real-time dan bisa dilihat juga dari layar kunci.

Video olahraga per kategori dan **6 jenis meditasi terpandu** (napas dan relaksasi / pengantar tidur / meredakan stres dan cemas / mengendalikan nafsu makan dan ngidam / fokus / rasa syukur) juga ada di aplikasi yang sama (HAVIT Premium). Meditasi ini juga berguna saat rasa lapar sebenarnya datang dari perasaan.

### 4. Kebiasaan yang bertahan karena terasa seperti main game

![Catatan berubah jadi hadiah dan kompetisi: streak, langkah, koin → tantangan, peringkat, karakter](/blog/havit/flow/id/havit-4-game.webp)

Setiap kali mencatat langkah, makan, dan tidur, Anda mengumpulkan koin. Anda bisa bersaing dengan teman lewat tantangan dan peringkat, lalu memakai koin untuk mengganti pakaian karakter. Karena setiap catatan langsung berbuah hadiah, Anda ingin membuka aplikasi setiap hari tanpa perlu disemangati orang lain.

- **Bertahan karena terasa seperti main game.** Ada streak, koin sesuai jumlah langkah, tantangan dan lencana, serta peringkat.

faq.question: Apa alternatif Shotsy terbaik di 2026?
faq.answer: Tergantung pada kesenjangan Anda. Untuk pelacak suntikan murni, MeAgain dan Pep adalah rekan yang dekat. Jika Anda menginginkan komposisi tubuh, pembentukan kebiasaan, dan pelatih AI bersama pencatatan dosis, aplikasi wellness all-in-one seperti HAVIT lebih cocok. Sesuaikan aplikasi dengan kebutuhan terbesar Anda — pelacakan, atau dukungan perjalanan lengkap.

faq.question: Apakah Shotsy pelacak GLP-1 yang bagus?
faq.answer: Ya. Shotsy melakukan pekerjaan intinya dengan baik: pencatatan dosis satu ketukan, peta rotasi lokasi suntikan visual, log efek samping yang terkait dosis, pengingat, dan dukungan 2026 untuk pil GLP-1 oral. Jika pelacak suntikan yang fokus adalah semua yang Anda butuhkan, ini adalah pilihan yang solid.

faq.question: Apakah Shotsy melacak komposisi tubuh atau massa otot?
faq.answer: Tidak. Shotsy melacak berat badan, tetapi bukan otot vs lemak. Karena bagian massa tanpa lemak dari penurunan berat badan GLP-1 telah mencapai 40–60% dalam beberapa uji coba, tampilan komposisi tubuh adalah di mana aplikasi all-in-one menambahkan nilai nyata dibandingkan pelacak suntikan saja.

faq.question: Apakah Shotsy gratis?
faq.answer: Fitur inti Shotsy gratis, dengan beberapa fitur lanjutan di balik langganan premium (umumnya sekitar $49,99/tahun). Verifikasi harga saat ini di App Store atau Google Play sebelum berlangganan.

faq.question: Apakah Shotsy memiliki pelatih AI?
faq.answer: Tidak. Pengingat Shotsy dijadwalkan, bukan percakapan. Jika Anda menginginkan asisten yang bereaksi terhadap protein Anda, efek samping, dan pola dan menyarankan langkah kecil berikutnya, cari aplikasi dengan pelatih AI adaptif.

faq.question: Shotsy vs MeAgain — mana yang lebih baik?
faq.answer: Keduanya adalah pelacak GLP-1 yang kuat. Shotsy bersih dan fokus pada suntikan; MeAgain memiliki set fitur all-in-one yang lebih luas dan nutrisi yang ditinjau RDN. Tidak ada yang memusatkan komposisi tubuh atau perubahan perilaku seperti yang dilakukan aplikasi wellness all-in-one — pilih berdasarkan kesenjangan mana yang paling penting bagi Anda.

faq.question: Bisakah saya beralih aplikasi di tengah perjalanan?
faq.answer: Ya, tetapi konsistensi lebih penting daripada aplikasi. Beralih hanya jika kesenjangan tertentu — komposisi tubuh, kebiasaan, pendampingan, atau bahasa — secara aktif merusak konsistensi Anda. Jika tidak, alat yang akan Anda buka setiap hari adalah yang tepat.

faq.question: Apakah aplikasi ini menggantikan nasihat medis?
faq.answer: Tidak. Shotsy, HAVIT, dan setiap aplikasi di sini adalah alat pelacakan, bukan dokter. Tampilan 'perkiraan tingkat obat' adalah perkiraan edukatif, bukan pengukuran. Ikuti dokter penulis resep dan apoteker Anda, dan gunakan pelacak Anda untuk membawa data yang lebih baik ke janji temu.

faq.question: Apakah HAVIT lebih baik dari Shotsy?
faq.answer: Tergantung pada apa yang Anda lacak. Shotsy dibangun untuk pencatatan kalori dan nutrisi umum. HAVIT dibangun di sekitar kursus GLP-1 — pencatatan dosis dan lokasi suntikan, pola efek samping yang terkait dengan waktu suntikan, komposisi tubuh, dan asupan protein untuk melindungi massa tanpa lemak. Jika Anda menggunakan GLP-1, HAVIT mencakup apa yang ditinggalkan pelacak umum; jika Anda hanya perlu menghitung kalori, Shotsy sudah cukup.

faq.question: Apa yang dilakukan HAVIT yang tidak dilakukan Shotsy?
faq.answer: Dosis dan rotasi lokasi suntikan, efek samping yang dicatat terhadap waktu suntikan, pelacakan tren komposisi tubuh, dan pendampingan kebiasaan yang beradaptasi dengan data yang Anda catat sendiri. HAVIT menggabungkan manajemen obat dan perubahan perilaku di satu tempat alih-alih membaginya di seluruh aplikasi.

faq.question: Bisakah saya beralih dari Shotsy ke HAVIT?
faq.answer: Ya. Kebanyakan orang menjalankan keduanya selama satu atau dua minggu — terus mencatat di mana Anda nyaman saat Anda menyiapkan kursus GLP-1 Anda di HAVIT — kemudian pindah setelah pengingat dosis dan riwayat efek samping sudah ada. Tidak ada yang berubah tentang resep Anda; HAVIT adalah pendamping pelacakan, bukan perangkat medis.

de.body_md:
*Medizinischer Haftungsausschluss: Dieser Artikel dient ausschließlich der allgemeinen Aufklärung und stellt keine medizinische Beratung, Diagnose oder Dosierungsempfehlung dar. GLP-1-Medikamente sind verschreibungspflichtige Arzneimittel mit ernsthaften potenziellen Risiken. Befolgen Sie stets die Anweisungen Ihres verschreibenden Arztes und die von der FDA zugelassene Kennzeichnung und ändern Sie niemals Ihre Dosis aufgrund einer App.*

Wenn Sie nach einer 'Shotsy-Alternative' gesucht haben, gefällt Ihnen wahrscheinlich bereits die Idee eines speziellen GLP-1-Trackers — Sie möchten nur wissen, ob etwas besser zu Ihrer Reise passt. Vielleicht wünschen Sie sich mehr als ein Spritzen-Protokoll: Körperzusammensetzung, Gewohnheitsbildung und Coaching, das Sie über die erste Woche hinaus konsequent hält. Dies ist ein ehrlicher, herstellerneutraler Vergleich. Shotsy ist eine wirklich gute App; wir werden klar darlegen, was sie gut macht und wo eine All-in-One-Wellness-App die Nase vorn hat.

## Was Shotsy gut macht

Shotsy ist um die wöchentliche (oder tägliche) GLP-1-Dosis herum aufgebaut und erledigt diese Aufgabe sauber.

### Ein-Tipp-Dosisprotokollierung und eine echte Injektionsstellen-Karte

Protokollieren Sie eine Spritze oder eine Tablette mit einem einzigen Tippen und führen Sie eine vollständige Medikamentenhistorie. Shotsy bietet Ihnen eine **visuelle Körperkarte zum Rotieren der Injektionsstellen** — das Feature, das einen speziell entwickelten Tracker von einer umfunktionierten Kalorien-App unterscheidet, denn wiederholtes Injizieren an derselben Stelle kann Knoten oder Reizungen verursachen ([Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/)).

### Intelligente Erinnerungen und Countdowns zur nächsten Dosis

Legen Sie präzise Zeitpläne für wöchentliche Injektionen oder tägliche orale Dosen fest, mit Countdowns und Benachrichtigungen zur nächsten Dosis, damit eine wöchentliche Spritze nicht an Ihnen vorbeigeht.

### Nebenwirkungsprotokollierung verknüpft mit Ihrer Dosis

Anpassbare Nebenwirkungsprotokolle ermöglichen es Ihnen, Übelkeit, Kopfschmerzen oder Müdigkeit zu erfassen und sie mit einer bestimmten Dosis, Stelle oder Mahlzeit zu verknüpfen — nützlich, weil 40–70 % der GLP-1-Anwender gastrointestinale Nebenwirkungen erleben ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/drug-development/glp-1-side-effects-only-one-factor-driving-patient-discontinuation-rates)).

### Breite Medikamentenunterstützung und 2026-Updates

Shotsy deckt Ozempic, Wegovy (Spritze und Tablette), Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda und mehr ab. Version 3.0 (März 2026) fügte **orale GLP-1-Tabletten-Tracking** und einen **Wartungsmodus** für Anwender am Zielgewicht hinzu, plus Ernährungs-, Protein- und Wasserprotokollierung und Apple Health-Synchronisation ([Shotsy im App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249)).

## Wo Shotsy für All-in-One-Anwender zu kurz kommt

Nichts davon ist ein Vorwurf an Shotsy — es ist ein fokussiertes Tool, das seine Kernaufgabe gut erfüllt. Aber 'großartiger Spritzen-Tracker' und 'verwaltet Ihre gesamte GLP-1-Reise' sind unterschiedliche Aufgaben. Hier ist die Lücke.

### 1. Keine Körperzusammensetzungsansicht

GLP-1-Gewichtsverlust ist nicht nur Fett. **Der Anteil der Magermasse am Gewichtsverlust unter GLP-1-Therapie lag in einigen Studien zwischen 40–60 % und in anderen bei 15 % oder weniger** ([Neeland et al., *Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism*, 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)). Shotsy verfolgt das Gewicht, hilft Ihnen aber nicht, Muskel vs. Fett zu sehen — die Zahl, die Ihnen sagt, ob Sie das *richtige* Gewicht verlieren.

### 2. Protokollierung, keine Verhaltensänderung

Shotsy zeichnet auf, was passiert ist. Das schwierigere Problem — konsequent durch Nebenwirkungswochen zu bleiben und Gewohnheiten aufzubauen, die das Medikament überdauern — ist das, was führende Leitlinien tatsächlich fordern: Die USPSTF empfiehlt intensive, multikomponentige **verhaltensorientierte** Interventionen für Erwachsene mit Adipositas ([USPSTF, Grad B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)). Ein Tracker protokolliert; er coacht nicht.

### 3. Kein adaptiver KI-Coach

Shotsys Erinnerungen sind geplant, nicht konversationell. Wenn Sie einen Assistenten möchten, der auf Ihr Protein, Ihre Nebenwirkungen und Ihre Muster reagiert — und den nächsten kleinen Schritt anstößt — ist das ein anderes Produkt.

### 4. Es ist ein Einzelzweck-Tool

Wenn Sie auch Essen, Protein, Körperzusammensetzung, Schritte und Gewohnheiten verfolgen, werden Sie Shotsy wahrscheinlich mit zwei oder drei anderen Apps zusammenfügen. Eine All-in-One-Lösung hält alles an einem Ort.

## Vergleichstabelle: Shotsy vs. eine All-in-One-GLP-1-App

*Funktionen und Preise ändern sich häufig — überprüfen Sie vor einer Verpflichtung im App Store oder Google Play. Quellen: [Shotsy](https://shotsyapp.com/), [Shotsy App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotsy-glp-1-tracker/id6499510249).*

## Wer sollte bei Shotsy bleiben — und wer sollte wechseln

**Bleiben Sie bei Shotsy, wenn:** Sie einen sauberen, fokussierten Spritzen-Tracker wünschen; die Injektionsstellen-Karte und Dosiserinnerungen Ihre oberste Priorität sind; und Sie bereits anderswo Essen verfolgen oder es nicht benötigen.

**Erwägen Sie eine Alternative, wenn:** Sie Körperzusammensetzung (Muskel vs. Fett), Gewohnheitsbildung und Coaching rund um die Spritze, einen KI-Assistenten oder eine App statt drei wünschen — oder Sie die Erfahrung lieber auf Koreanisch, Japanisch oder Traditionellem Chinesisch hätten.

## Worauf Sie bei einer Shotsy-Alternative achten sollten

1. **Dosis + geführte Injektionsstellen-Rotation** — der unverzichtbare Kern, den Shotsy bereits beherrscht.
2. **Körperzusammensetzung** — Muskel vs. Fett, nicht nur Waagenwert, damit Sie Magermasse schützen.
3. **Protein-first-Ernährungsprotokollierung** — der Appetit sinkt bei einem GLP-1; zu wenig Protein zu essen riskiert Muskelverlust.
4. **Gewohnheits- und Verhaltensänderungsunterstützung** — der Teil, der Sie monatelang konsequent hält.
5. **Ein adaptiver Coach** — Anleitung, die auf Ihre Daten reagiert, nicht nur ein geplanter Ping.
6. **Datenschutz** — die meisten US-Wellness-Apps sind nicht HIPAA-konform; bevorzugen Sie klare Export-/Löschkontrollen.

## Das Fazit

Shotsy ist eine starke, ehrliche Empfehlung für jeden, der einen speziellen GLP-1-Spritzen-Tracker möchte — die Injektionsstellen-Karte und Erinnerungen sind wirklich gut. Die Lücke ist alles *rund um* die Spritze: Körperzusammensetzung, Gewohnheiten und Coaching. Wenn Sie das Medikamentenprotokoll **und** den Muskel, die Gewohnheiten und einen KI-Coach an einem Ort wünschen, ist eine All-in-One-Lösung die bessere Shotsy-Alternative.

Wenn das auf Sie zutrifft, **[probieren Sie die HAVIT-App](https://www.aihavit.com/)** — Dosisprotokollierung, Protein-first-Ernährungstracking, Körperzusammensetzung, Gewohnheitsbildung und ein KI-Coach, entwickelt, um Sie Woche für Woche konsequent zu halten.

## HAVIT: Ernährung, Nährwerte und Kalorien – und dein ganzer gesunder Lebensstil in einer App

GLP-1-Medikamente können das Gewicht bedeutsam reduzieren — aber die Waage ist nur ein Teil der Geschichte. Der Anteil der Magermasse am Gewichtsverlust unter GLP-1-Therapie lag in einigen Studien zwischen 40–60 % und in anderen bei 15 % oder weniger — und Magermasse umfasst Organe, Knochen und Flüssigkeit, nicht nur Muskel ([Neeland et al., 2024](https://dom-pubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/dom.15728)), und die Ergebnisse neigen dazu zu verblassen, sobald das Medikament gestoppt wird, es sei denn, neue Gewohnheiten treten an ihre Stelle — weshalb die USPSTF intensive, multikomponentige verhaltensorientierte Interventionen empfiehlt ([USPSTF, Grad B](https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/obesity-in-adults-interventions)).

**HAVIT ist eine KI-Diät-Coach-App, entwickelt von Fachleuten aus Juvis Diet, einer der führenden Diätkliniken Koreas.** HAVIT erfasst nicht nur Mahlzeiten, Nährwerte und Kalorien. In einer einzigen App begleitet sie deinen ganzen gesunden Lebensstil, von der Körperzusammensetzung über Schlaf und Bewegung bis zum mentalen Wohlbefinden. In der Klinik haben Fachleute die Mitglieder persönlich in drei Schritten begleitet: „Körper analysieren → Ziele in Zahlen festlegen → täglich coachen“. Genau diesen Ablauf bildet die App nach.

Schlaf, Wasser, Fasten, Zyklus und GLP-1 trackst du kostenlos, und HAVI kommentiert jeden dieser Einträge.
